def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # recolor the column immediately left of the leftmost non-background object
    bg=grid[0][0]
    cols=[c for r in grid for c,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg and v!=2]
    c=min(cols)-1
    if c>=0:
        for r in out: r[c]=8
    return out

code='''def transform(grid):
    """Move the non-background shape toward the full marker line, with an 8 separator."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full row/column of 2 is the marker; the uniform border/background color
    # is the most common cell value outside the shape.
    marker_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    if marker_rows:
        mr = marker_rows[0]
        bg = grid[0][0]
        points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in points), max(r for r,c in points)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in points), max(c for r,c in points)
        shape = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        out[mr] = grid[mr][:]
        if mr < r0:
            nr0 = mr+1
            for dr,row in enumerate(shape):
                out[nr0+dr][c0:c1+1] = row
            sep = nr0+len(shape)
        else:
            nr0 = mr-len(shape)
            for dr,row in enumerate(shape):
                out[nr0+dr][c0:c1+1] = row
            sep = nr0-1
        out[sep] = [8]*w
        return out
    mc = marker_cols[0]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    points = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in points),max(r for r,c in points)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in points),max(c for r,c in points)
    shape=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h): out[r][mc]=2
    if mc > c1:
        nc0=mc-len(shape[0])
        for r in range(r0,r1+1): out[r][nc0:nc0+len(shape[0])] = shape[r-r0]
        sep=nc0-1
    else:
        nc0=mc+1
        for r in range(r0,r1+1): out[r][nc0:nc0+len(shape[0])] = shape[r-r0]
        sep=nc0+len(shape[0])
    for r in range(h): out[r][sep]=8
    return out
'''
